notes.title: Ghost Town OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33026102/eba459f2841cf402f4f6b0b0854568a7692be3fd.jpg[/img]

The wait is finally over! [u][b]GHOST TOWN IS OUT NOW[/b][/u] on Steam with a 10% launch discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/

We've been hard at work crafting Ghost Town over the past 4 years(!) so we're super excited to get it in to your hands & to hear what you think of it. 

As an independent developer, reviews play a big part in raising awareness of the game while also directly telling us what you thought about it. Please show your support by writing a review, we'll be actively keeping an eye out for any coming through! 

We hope you enjoy exploring the world of Ghost Town!

- Fireproof Games

notes.title: THE ROOM VR: A DARK MATTER PRICE REDUCTION
notes.content:
[h1]The Room VR: A Price Reduction[/h1]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33026102/c44b463730bf0c015948708c028bd40c616a52b8.png[/img]
As of March this year, The Room VR: A Dark Matter has been out for 5 years!

We're super proud that The Room VR continued the [i]Overwhelmingly Positive[/i] tradition of The Room series, achieving that rating across more than 3500 reviews.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104380/The_Room_VR_A_Dark_Matter

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280431/5dc73919ba3243ceb896dc79951b8cea3f687b31.jpg[/img]

Hello there!

It's been a while, so we figured a couple of update are in order!

[h1]Ghost Town - Meta Quest Store launch[/h1]
We've been keeping busy since our initial announcement last October getting Ghost Town all polished up for it's Meta Quest store release, which happened last Thursday!

The reception has been wonderful to see, with critic and player reviews almost unanimously positive so far. We've been glued to our screens waiting on every new video, review or comment to come through!

[url=https://www.uploadvr.com/ghost-town-vr-review/]Upload VR[/url] put together a particularly glowing piece if anyone fancies a bit of further reading!

[h1]Ghost Town - Steam release coming soon[/h1]
Now that Ghost Town has released on Quest we're focussing our attention on the PC (Steam) & PSVR2 versions. We don't quite have a date in the calendar that we can share yet, however as soon as we're confident on a launch day we'll let you know!

Wishlist below to keep on top of any new updates -
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/?curator_clanid=33026102

[h1]Fireproof Games Sale![/h1]
In celebration of the Ghost Town's Meta launch, we're running a 2 week sale, which is live NOW, on all of our other games! This sale is the biggest we've ever done across all our title so if you were looking to grab one now's the time!

notes.title: Ghost Town announcement! A new VR puzzle adventure from the developers of The Room series!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33026102/2c78d9e9304c9a14d21e4d40a1b8321b9a0b02e2.gif[/img]

We're thrilled to announce [i][u][b]Ghost Town[/b][/u][/i], our new single-player puzzle adventure VR game! We've been working away on this for the past 4/5 years so it's super exciting for us to finally show it off!

[i]London, 1983. Edith Penrose, a witch turned ghost hunter, is kept busy running her paranormal detective agency. But after her brother goes missing Edith must draw upon her wits & supernatural talents to unravel the mystery.[/i]
[i]
Step in to the boots of Edith and explore an array of atmospheric locations using your trusty torch to light your way. Use the unique physicality of VR to overcome tactile puzzles, activate sigils and move troubled spirits on to the next world.[/i]

The store page is live now, with an announcement trailer & a few screenshots to whet the appetite! And why not add [i][b]Ghost Town[/b][/i] to your wishlist while you're over there! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/

notes.title: Puzzle box 'em up The Room celebrates its 10th anniversary with a series-wide sale next month
notes.content:
Puzzlebox solve ‘em up The Room entered the scene ten years ago, so developers Fireproof Games are celebrating the milestone anniversary with deep discounts across the entire slightly spooky series. From September 1st to September 14th, every single game in the puzzler series will enjoy a discount of up to 90% on Steam. Similarly big sales are taking place across the Nintendo eShop (until September 22nd) and the Google Play Store (until September 8th), if you wanted to take the lovely headscratchers on the go. Or to the comfort of your own bed.

Read more

notes.title: The Room 4: Old Sins - OUT NOW!!!
notes.content:
The day is finally here! The Room 4: Old Sins is [b][u]available now[/u][/b] on Steam for PC!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361320/The_Room_4_Old_Sins/
Much like with The Room Three's PC release back in 2018, Old Sins has been a [i]frequently[/i] requested title since it's mobile launch and something we've been working away on since the start of 2020. It's been a very different development cycle for us this time around with everyone working from home, however it hasn't stopped us creating something we're super proud of!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38971635/523a98ccb30cba48cc7902b08923712ec57b7b74.jpg[/img]

A massive thank you to all our fans for your patience and support! We hope you love Old Sins as much as we do and enjoy exploring every inch of Waldegrave Manor!

Take care and happy clicking!

- Fireproof Games Team
